title: 2 Things You Didn't Know About the Shelby Cobra
description:
The Shelby Cobra, one of the most famous American cars ever made, started as a British car with no engine, shipped by air to California. And its most famous version, the four hundred twenty-seven, had a rule it never met. The rules said a hundred had to be built. Wikipedia says only fifty-six were. These are the two things about the Shelby Cobra that most people do not know. Here is the twist. The first Cobra was finished in under eight hours. And the car that people call the fastest Cobra of all was not allowed to race in the year it was built. One of the things we will show you also explains why a single Cobra later sold for thirteen point seven five million dollars. Stay to the end.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
